title: Release worktree-admin lock around the merge verify child
action: Restructure mergeFeatureWorktree (.bee/bin/lib/worktree-store.mjs ~1300-1525) so the 'worktree-admin' lock is released before the verify spawnSync child runs and re-acquired for the post-verify write step, re-checking preconditions after re-acquire (merge target unchanged, worktree still registered). Test asserts the lock file is absent while the child runs and that precondition drift after re-acquire aborts untouched. Regen inside this cell after the code change: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node skills/bee-hive/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write.

post-reacquire precondition re-check aborts untouched on drift
red verify still aborts merge untouched
prohibitions: no lock held across any long-running child
